Submission Description: (doc-less) Out-of-Time Motion to Intervene of EQUINIX INC. under EL26-108-000.

Submission Date:        10/20/2026 8:57:21 PM

Filed Date:             10/21/2026 8:30:00 AM

Dockets
-------
EL26-108-000         PJM Interconnection, L.L.C.

Filing Party/Contacts:

Filing Party                             Signer (Representative)                  Other Contact (Principal)               
------------                             -----------------------                  -------------------------               
EQUINIX INC.                             ahaubenstock@equinix.com                 cmcgeady@equinix.com                    

Basis for Intervening:
Equinix is one of the oldest and largest data center developers, owners and operators in the world, with numerous data centers throughout the PJM footprint, including both colocation data centers and larger data centers with a single or limited number of customers.  Its interest would be directly affected by the outcome of this proceeding, and its interests could not be adequately represented by any other party.   As Equinix is submitting this motion to intervene after hours on the date twenty-one days after this proceeding was instituted, there would be no negative effect on the interests of any party by its intervention.
